verses.text: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron, his sons, and the leaders of Israel.
He said to Aaron, "Take a young bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both with nothing wrong with them, and offer them to the LORD.
Then tell the people of Israel, 'Take a male goat for a sin offering, and a calf and a lamb, both one year old and with nothing wrong with them, for a burnt offering.
Also take a bull and a ram for peace offerings to offer to the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will show himself to you.'"
They brought what Moses commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting. The whole community came near and stood in front of the LORD.
Moses said, "This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD will appear to you."

Moses said to Aaron, "Come to the altar and offer your sin offering and your burnt offering, to make yourself and the people right with God. Then offer the people's offering to make them right with God, as the LORD has commanded."
So Aaron came to the altar and killed the calf as a sin offering for himself.
His sons brought him the blood. He dipped his finger in it and put it on the horns of the altar, and he poured out the rest of the blood at the bottom of the altar.
He burned on the altar the fat, the kidneys, and the fatty covering of the liver from the sin offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
He burned the meat and the skin in a fire outside the camp.
Then he killed the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it all around the altar.
They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, with the head, and he burned them on the altar.
He washed the inside parts and the legs, and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.
Then he brought the people's offering. He took the goat for the people's sin offering, killed it, and offered it for sin, just as he did with the first one.
He brought the burnt offering and offered it in the way that had been commanded.
He brought the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar, along with the morning burnt offering.
He also killed the bull and the ram as peace offerings for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he splashed it all around the altar.
They also handed him the fat from the bull and the ram: the fat tail, the fat covering the inside parts, the kidneys, and the fatty covering of the liver.
They put the fat on top of the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.
Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh in front of the LORD as a wave offering, as Moses had commanded.
Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them. After offering the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, he came down.
Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people, and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.
Fire came out from the LORD and burned up the burnt offering and the fat on the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted for joy and bowed down with their faces to the ground.
